description: Reads the events Reclaim sent to the organization's pull listener, and decodes them: each result event is decrypted and signature-verified into `result`, and each lifecycle event returns its `eventData`. Call it to try a provider without an app or to check what Reclaim sent for a session. Creates the listener on first use, so it is not read-only. Filter with `sessionId`, or pass the previous `next` as `after` to read on. Items with a lower sequence can appear late, so for a complete read use `pending: true`. Returns `{ listener, items, next }`. Encrypted results need the `RECLAIM_DECRYPT_KEY` that matches the org keypair. To deliver events to your app's callback route, call `proxy_callback_events`.

after.description: The `next` value of a previous call.

orgToken.description: The organization API key (`rorg_…`). Defaults to the server's `RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET`, then the key saved by `issue_org_token`. Never echo it back to the user.

pending.description: Only events not yet acknowledged. `proxy_callback_events` acknowledges the events it delivers.

sessionId.description: Only events of this verification session.

name: read_callback_events
